notes.title: Finalist for NZ GameFest awards!
notes.content:
Thrilled to announce that Sue's Story is a finalist for two categories in the prestigious annual NZ GamesFest awards, the PAV awards, which will be decided on 26th April. 

Sue's Story is a finalist for two categories:
 - Grand Prize
 - Excellence in Audio

More information here:  [url=https://nzgamesfest.com/the-pavs/2021-finalists/]https://nzgamesfest.com/the-pavs/2021-finalists/[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.7.8 release notes.
notes.content:
A number of changes have been applied including:
1) moving the shuttle bay decompression chamber checkpoint further away from the door to fix spawning location issues.
2) reducing a large amount of unused files form the installation pack which has reduced the install size by nearly a gig!

Note - some players have reported an issue with the ACTIVATE and JUMP buttons being both mapped to E. This can be fixed by resetting mapping to defaults. If you are using a game controller, you also may find turning off Steam Controller input settings in Big Screen helpful.

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.7.7 Patch released
notes.content: This patch fixes an issue with the piping on the walls for climbing across the exhaust conduit in the area just prior to the Shuttle bay.

notes.title: 1.7.5 Sprint hotfix
notes.content:
Finally the obscure sprint issue has been fixed.  :-)

notes.title: Sue's Story 1.7.4 released
notes.content:
This patch completes the Non-Steam Gamepad controller support so that the inventory and menu systems also work with the xbox and pc game controllers for those who are not using the default Steam Input controller mapping configuration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721991/3a63ce777962ffdf4b07c611cab1e8b560e1c17f.png[/img]

For Steam users you will need to FORCE OFF your automatic assigned Steam Input configuration mapping. These work very well actually, and we have recently uploaded a specific "official XBOX configuration" for PC Users, however some may not be running the game via Steam, and this provides a fully configurable alternative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721991/306969ca489b39214c8b26c7b9a6a2c2244c3545.png[/img]

I'm very keen on having anyone provide feedback on how this is working, and if there are any situations where the controller doesn't cover all game functionality. I have a feeling there are some - but need help finding them.  

Thanks for your help!

notes.title: Sue's Story v1.7.3 patch released.
notes.content:
This patch applies a few minor bug fixes, adds basic non-steam game controller support for movement and basic interaction, adds 55 secrets hidden throughout the levels, and additional achievements awarded when they are found.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37721991/0294ef1cc82ea05feac7b757251ecbd76ee45886.png[/img]

notes.title: Sue's Story v1.6.8 patch released.
notes.content:
Hi all,

This patch fixes a few bugs which in some cases prevents a player from leaving the port cargo hold into the shuttle, as well as a few other minor bugs and tweaks.

An additional objective is added to help players find their way out of the very first cryochamber in the game!

Watch this space, we are adding XBOX controller support shortly.

notes.title: Version 1.6.6 Released
notes.content:
A new patch has been released. This cleans up a number of small issues and defects, and hopefully improves gameplay experience.

Improvements include:
1) first person and 3rd person modes simplified with V toggle. first person forced in crouch spaces, ladders and combat,.
2) how forced crouched spaces work
3) backpack volume/weight management simplified and some bugs fixed
4) improvements to ladder climbing camera control
5) numerous little fixes and tweaks to levels

notes.title: Sue's Story 1.4.1 Patch released
notes.content:
This patch fixes the problem with the headset in the shuttle not being able to be picked up, as well as some key access cards on the Starboard for driving the forklift.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Releasing 3rd August!
notes.content:
After months of work, the parallel story to Discrepant, called Sue's Story, will be available from 3rd August. Released free to enjoy!

The game picks up whether the tutorial ended in Discrepant, with Sue awakening in a Cryo transport ship, and ultimately collapsing on her way to escape to the shuttle. The tutorial was a hint of the rest of the story, but actually Discrepant starts in New Haven.

In New Haven, Sebastian interacts with Sue on multiple occasions in Discrepant, but we never fully find out what happened to Sue before Discrepant, and how she came to be where and what she is. Sue's Story aims to fill in a big part of that part of the story. It is set exclusively in Space, and takes you on her journey through various ships, solving puzzles and trying to get in control of her own personal turmoil before reaching out to Sebastian.

No knowledge of Discrepant is required, you can just enjoy it for what it is, a playful adventure strongly tied to the likes to the Alien genre.
